company.shortDescription: Trestle Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company that introduces bioengineered kidneys for patients with kidney disease.
company.description:
Trestle Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company that introduces bioengineered kidneys for patients with kidney disease.

The company's services allow healthcare providers to reduce their reliance on dialysis while also enhancing the disease status of renal patients through the combination of stem cell biology and bio-fabrication.

Trestle Biotherapeutics was founded in 2020 by Alice Chen and Ben Shepherd and is based in San Diego, California, United States.

productsAndServices.description: An implantable therapeutic tissue designed to treat patients with end stage renal disease by reducing or eliminating the need for dialysis and delaying transplantation.
productsAndServices.name: Implantable Bioengineered Kidney Tissue

items.description: Trestle Biotherapeutics and Humacyte have announced a research collaboration to explore technology synergies for bioengineering vascularized organs for transplantation. This partnership aims to integrate Trestle Bio's biofabricated human kidney tissues with Humacyte's acellular tissue engineered vessels, potentially advancing solutions for end stage renal disease.
